{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the premises
print("Shape:", df.shape)
print("\n'converted' unique values:", df['converted'].unique())
print("'customer_age' unique values:", df['customer_age'].unique())
print("\nNumber of -1 in customer_age:", (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())
print("\nNumber of converted customers:", (df['converted'] == 1).sum())

# Check if any non-converted rows are included in the population
print("\nRows where converted == 1:", (df['converted'] == 1).sum())

# Confirm the population is only converted customers
converted_df = df[df['converted'] == 1]
print("\nMean age of converted customers (raw):", converted_df['customer_age'].mean())

# Check for -1 values in converted group
missing_in_converted = (converted_df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
print("\nNumber of -1 values among converted customers:", missing_in_converted)

# Now compute mean age excluding -1 values
valid_ages = converted_df[converted_df['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()

print(f"\nMean age of converted customers, excluding -1 sentinels: {mean_age:.2f}")"}
